sections.heading: CERTIFICATE IN MUSEUM AND CURATORIAL STUDIES - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Visual Arts

Admission to this certificate is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the certificate will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the certificate requirements by August 31, 2028.

Completion of first-year requirements including 1.0 course either from Art History 1640 or the former VAH 1040, or two of Art History 1641A/B, Art History 1642A/B, Art History 1644A/B, Art History 1646A/B or Art History 1648A/B or the former VAH 1041A/B, the former VAH 1042A/B, the former VAH 1043A/B, the former VAH 1044A/B, and the former VAH 1045A/B, with a minimum grade of 60% in each course.
2.0 course: Museum and Curatorial Studies 2600 or above or the former VAH 2292F/G, the former VAH 2296F/G, the former VAH 3386F/G, or the former VAH 4485E.
1.0 courses from: Museum and Curatorial Studies or Art History 2600-level or above or above or the former VAH 2200-level or above.
For modules that can and cannot be combined, please visit the Visual Arts Modular Checklist site https://www.uwo.ca/visarts/undergraduate/Modules.html
